snippet.title: Department Of Collections Gameplay/Cinematic Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Department of Collections is a 1-4 player coop horror game where you dive deeper into a facility discovering at the command of your employers. Complete tasks, dive deeper, and survive. And remember, the elevator only goes one way.

The levels are fully procedural from the loot and room layouts, down to the furniture and obstacle placement. Can you reach the end and discover more about the world you are living in?

Wishlist the game on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962340/Department_of_Collections/
Join the discord: https://discord.gg/gp2eE93EzQ
